paper_title: RADES axion search results with a High-Temperature Superconducting cavity in an 11.7 T magnet
notes: RADES haloscope search with high-temperature superconducting (ReBCO) cavity in 11.7 T dipole magnet at CERN. Data taken 13-15 November 2021, 27 h at ~8.84 GHz resonant frequency. No signal excess found. Exclusion limit varies across the narrow mass range 36.5676–36.5699 µeV (554 kHz width) due to varying cavity sensitivity across the tuning range caused by helium pressure fluctuations. The limit improves previous RADES result by factor of 2.5. Local dark matter density ρ_a = 0.45 GeV/cm³ used in standard haloscope analysis (equation 4.5).
